channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Solomon Hill | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Solomon Hill from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Pat Riley on Solomon Hill
item.description:
“Today is a very good day because we think the acquisition of Andre, Jae and Solomon will help us with our versatility and create a more balanced roster,”

Pat Riley on Solomon Hill, Feb 6, 2020. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Dell Demps on Solomon Hill
item.description:
general manager Dell Demps told The Advocate.

“I am optimistic and hopeful that Solomon will contribute to the Pelicans having a successful season.”

Dell Demps on Solomon Hill, Nov 20, 2018. Source: The Advocate.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Solomon Hill
item.description:
Vogel said after the win.

“I just wanted to get Solomon in there somehow. Chase was the guy that we had to pull out. It wasn’t anything that Chase had done.”

Frank Vogel on Solomon Hill, Jan 3, 2016. Source: Vigilant Sports.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Solomon Hill
item.description:
Third-year wing Solomon Hill has played so well that coach Frank Vogel said he couldn’t keep him out of the rotation.

“Solomon Hill’s been giving us something in the last couple of games when he’s been called upon,”

Frank Vogel on Solomon Hill, Jan 3, 2016. Source: Vigilant Sports.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Solomon Hill
item.description:
Frank Vogel:

“I’m excited about coaching this game. That’s the hardest thing about coaching when you have guys that deserve minutes that you don’t have minutes for Solomon and Joe definitely deserve minutes and haven’t gotten them thus far but they’ll get them tonight.”

Frank Vogel on Solomon Hill, Nov 16, 2015. Source: Twitter @CandaceDBuckner.
